notes: Source of truth for every vLLM V1 Prometheus metric name. The PrometheusStatLogger class (line ~466) constructs each metric with an explicit name= kwarg; grepping name="vllm: yields 39 names in this file, plus 7 in vllm/v1/spec_decode/metrics.py. Verified by reading main branch on 2026-10-04. | 2026-10-05 PATH SWEEP: PATH SWEEP RESULT: NO REPAIR NEEDED, AND THIS IS A REPORTED NON-FINDING WORTH RECORDING. An agent reported that vLLM's metric collectors had moved out of vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, which would have made this record's URL a stale first-party citation. That report is NOT borne out. This record's url is https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/main/vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py and the file is still there on main: the authenticated recursive tree for vllm@main (8,567 entries, truncated=false, so the listing is complete and a miss is a real miss) contains vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, and that same listing contains the sibling buckets.py. The second cited path also survives: vllm/v1/spec_decode/metrics.py is present on main, independently confirmed by an authenticated code search for the vllm:spec_decode metric prefix, which returns that file. Nothing here is stale.
